run.name: PENN Entertainment, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (PENN)
run.summary: PENN's credit profile is improving, with strong near-term liquidity and a longer bank maturity profile, but large landlord obligations outside debt and a still loss-making online segment keep the view cautious. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 2806.6 less cash 1044.8 over LTM Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA 1088.2. Same basis and exclusions. On a perimeter adding financing obligations and finance leases, 6.59x gross and 5.63x net (see Calculations).

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA 1088.2 over LTM cash interest 382.4, calculated as 383.0 less 292.2 plus 291.6 (nine-month figures). Not the covenant coverage ratio, whose definition is not supplied.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash from 10-Q Q3 page:2. Revolver 1000.0 undrawn less 23.9 letters of credit (10-Q Q3 page:18). Excludes restricted cash of 29.3. Revolver matures April 2031.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Credit agreement, indentures, lease texts and ratings are not supplied, so covenant headroom and creditor protections cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant ratios and definitions are not supplied, so covenant headroom cannot be measured.
